'''Herzfall Corporation''',<ref name="ISB" /> also known as '''Herzfall Communications''',<ref name="HNN46" /> was a small communications corporation based in [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], developing lightweight communications gear.<ref name="ISB" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Herzfall signed an endorsement deal with [[Deme Tryshyn]], a [[Grav-ball/Legends|grav-ball]] player who was the highest scorer in the history of the sport.<ref name="HNN46">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|sports/1337_1.html|Tryshyn / Ardees Deal Worth 3.1 Billion}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Herzfall produced the [[DH107/Legends|DH107]] which was used by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="ISB" />
